title: TLS checks disabled (mysql) — review required
description: mysql is told to skip TLS verification: --ssl-modes*=s*DISABLED. Scripted clients then accept any certificate, exposing automation credentials and data. This lexical rule flags the flag; the reviewer confirms it is test-only or removes it.
remediation: Remove the flag and trust via REQUIRED or stricter modes.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the flag regardless of environment.
